en: Black‑and‑white postcard showing a snowy outdoor scene at what appears to be a freight or postal depot. Several men in long coats and military- or official-looking uniforms stand in front of a wooden loading platform piled high with parcels and boxes. Behind them are rail freight cars or storage wagons. Handwritten text in a cursive script appears in the right margin, and a reference number is written at the top edge.
